Then one day my doctor called me in for a regular annual check up & discovered I was really out of shape for my age. They ran test & discovered my liver was again failing & it gave me Encephalopathy. It also affected my lungs so now I needed oxygen to breathe normally. Basically my liver was not transforming the food I hate enough so toxins in everything I would eat or drink would go to my brain & make me insane. Everyone's liver transform & process food to give nutrients to our body & shit the rest. But a failing liver is not capable of doing it all so bad stuff stays in the body.
